cl.x: Provide LANKO 752 Bondit where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.01).

LANKO 752 Bondit is a P.V.A. based emulsion for use as a mortar additive, primer and sealer. LANKO 752 Bondit increases the adhesion, flexibility, tensile strength and impact resistance of mortars. Also suitable for bonding timber to timber.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Mixed with water and applied to concrete surfaces for priming, dustproofing and sealing. As an additive to sand/cement for concrete patching applications. As an additive in sand/cement for rendering applications. As an additive in mortars for tiling over concrete, render, blockwork and rendered brickwork surfaces. As a slurry into neat cement for bonding new sand/cement toppings onto concrete surfaces. For bonding timber onto timber.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Application Information > Consumption
cl.x: Joinery: Approximately 3.5m²/L when used neat, depending upon surface porosity and site conditions. Priming: 6-8m²/L when diluted with water and applied with a brush or roller. Mortar Addition: Approximately 750 mL to 1L of LANKO 752 Bondit with required water to each 20 kg of sand/cement mix.

s: Do not use LANKO 752 Bondit in temperatures above 40ºC and below 5ºC.
Do not use LANKO 752 Bondit in permanently wet or damp areas such as swimming pools and spas. In these types of installations, use Davco Lanko 751 Lankolatex.
LANKO 752 Bondit is not recommended for the bonding of plastic or rubber.
